responsibility: Implements the core non-inline runtime support for GCC’s GIMPLE IR. It owns statement allocation and size tables derived from gimple.def, code-name and structure mappings, constructors such as gimple_build_return and other tuple builders, alias-info reset for calls, sequence utilities like location setting and discard, miscellaneous statement helpers such as call-argument trimming and inexpensive-call classification, and checking-mode selftests for the basic GIMPLE data structures and printers.
same_name_distinction: Implementation companion to gcc/gimple.h and the generated definitions from gcc/gimple.def: it turns the code inventory into runtime tables such as code names and structure mappings, and provides the non-inline allocation, construction, sequence, and helper routines that the header only declares or inlines.
